tool_args.rationale: The attempted memory ODE failed fresh confirmation, so switch to the compact archived inland-hub siphon law: a sink-inhibited saturating source plus an open-sign square-root branch. The existing rows span source and sink values adequately for numerical fitting of its three parameters; the unoffered slow-horizon and branch-discriminating probes are deferred.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The prior numerical fit was explicitly refuted on fresh confirmation with RMSE about 1.64, far above tolerance; do not repeat that mechanism.
Its archived note requires a slow-horizon discriminating probe; the currently supplied probe menu does not offer that probe, and no evidence supports committing to its extra time scales.
The observed maximum sink gradient is 2.2, below its stated threshold region, so an avalanche term is not supported.
It is expressly irrelevant to mechanism identification and incurs cost without resolving the model discrepancy.
